title: Keyboard, mouse & trackpad
blurb: Keys typing wrong, mouse frozen, trackpad not clicking, touch screen.

remedies.title: Type accents, symbols or emoji
remedies.why: Both systems have pickers for emoji and symbols, and shortcuts for accents.

steps.text: Windows+. (full stop) opens emoji, symbols and kaomoji.
Add the US-International keyboard for easy accents (' then e = é).
Hold a letter key to pick an accent; Control+⌘+Space for emoji and symbols.

remedies.title: Handy keyboard shortcuts
remedies.why: A few shortcuts save a lot of clicking.

steps.text: Copy/paste/undo: Ctrl+C / V / Z. Switch apps: Alt+Tab. Lock: Windows+L. Desktop: Windows+D. Snip: Windows+Shift+S. Search: Windows key and type.
Copy/paste/undo: ⌘C / V / Z. Switch apps: ⌘Tab. Lock: Ctrl+⌘+Q. Spotlight: ⌘Space. Screenshot: ⌘+Shift+4. Force quit: ⌘+Option+Esc.

remedies.title: Swap mouse buttons or change what the buttons do
remedies.why: Basic button settings are in the system; extra buttons need the mouse maker's app.

steps.text: Settings › Bluetooth & devices › Mouse › Primary mouse button.
Logitech Options+, Razer Synapse and others control extra buttons.

remedies.title: Mouse pointer is too small or hard to find
remedies.why: Pointer size and colour can be changed for comfort.

steps.text: Accessibility › Mouse pointer and touch: size and colour.
Accessibility › Display › Pointer: size, colours, and "Shake mouse pointer to locate".

remedies.title: F1–F12 keys change volume/brightness instead (or the other way round)
remedies.why: Laptops share the top row between media and F-keys; Fn lock switches which comes first.

steps.text: Press Fn+Esc (many laptops) to toggle Fn lock, or hold Fn with the key.
Some laptops set this in the BIOS/UEFI (Action keys mode) or the maker's app.
Keyboard › Keyboard Shortcuts › Function Keys › Use F1, F2, etc. keys as standard function keys.

remedies.title: Keys repeat too much (or not at all) when held
remedies.why: Key repeat speed and delay, or Filter/Slow Keys, change how held keys behave.

steps.text: Keyboard properties: Repeat delay and rate (Control Panel › Keyboard).
Keyboard › Key repeat rate and Delay until repeat.
Double letters from one press on a laptop can be a worn key: try an external keyboard.
